faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant - Adm & Accts Recruitment 2026?

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant - Adm & Accts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Assistant - Adm & Accts post in this recruitment drive. This is a good opportunity for eligible candidates seeking government jobs.

faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Project Assistant - Adm & Accts recruitment. This makes it accessible for all eligible candidates to apply.

faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Project Assistant - Adm & Accts post must not exceed 65 years of age. Age relaxation rules may apply as per government norms, if specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Assistant - Adm & Accts at IIT Kharagpur?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Assistant - Adm & Accts post is up to Rs. 25000 per month. This is a competitive salary package for a contractual position in a reputed institution.

faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelors degree in the appropriate discipline with a minimum of 15 years working experience from a reputed institute. Ensure you meet all educational and experience criteria before applying.

faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of IIT Kharagpur or by using the direct apply link provided in the Important Links section of this article. Follow the instructions carefully.

faq.answer: The Project Assistant - Adm & Accts posts are contractual in nature. This means the employment will be for a specific period, as outlined in the official notification.

faq.answer: The job location for the Project Assistant - Adm & Accts post is Kharagpur, West Bengal. Candidates should be prepared to relocate or commute to this location if selected.
